title: Growth config: SPONSORED_PROMOTION_POLICY
description: Rules of provider-sponsored promotions (GRW-P2-S, ADR-048 Proposed): the commission basis, the high-value review thresholds and the funding defaults. The clinic funds its own promotion; it is never a Kiorex discount and never a conversion of credit. Money relevant: effective at least 7 days after approval, two approvers. Added in contracts 1.12.0 (Rev 2.6). PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified. Unknown keys rejected.

commissionBasis.description: GROSS_BEFORE_SPONSORED (default): the Kiorex fee is computed on the fee before any sponsored discount. NET_AFTER_SPONSORED exists for a future percentage model only.

highValueBudgetMinor.description: A promotion budget cap at or above this needs a second approver.

highValuePerBookingMinor.description: A per-booking discount at or above this needs a second approver.

maxDiscountBp.description: A percent discount above this needs a second approver. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3000.

reservationTtlGraceMinutes.description: Reservation lives as long as the hold plus this grace.

reviewRequired.description: Every promotion version goes through the advertising review. PROPOSED_DEFAULT true; not switchable off in production.

fraudRuleWeights.description: Shadow-mode weights of the promotion fraud signals.
